reuse.why: Reuses ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked (registered the same way as the other providers), findOrCreateBank, syncAccount, handleSyncResponse and the provider registries, but writes the create-or-upgrade-and-sync body again instead of sharing it with the other link functions.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount copies the SimpleFin/Akahu link body nearly line for line and downloadFintegraTransactions copies downloadEnableBankingTransactions, two more copies of per-provider logic.

placement.why: Link handler and its wrapped registration in accounts/app.ts, download and dispatch in accounts/sync.ts, URL in server-config.ts and types in types/models, matching where the tree puts each provider's pieces.

scope.why: Only the server pieces needed for the new provider plus one test.

maintainability.why: Consistent with the existing per-provider pattern and easy to read, but adds to the copies that every provider-wide change must touch.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The link guard is applied through the same app.method wrapper as the other providers; no shared link-finishing helper exists to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions in accounts/sync.ts is downloadEnableBankingTransactions with the body compacted onto fewer lines, and linkFintegraAccount in accounts/app.ts repeats the SimpleFin link body with a compressed payee insert.
